title: Crossy Road Celebration Frames
summary: 13 celebration jump-peak sprites. Arms up, airborne, stars + confetti + checkmark.
content:
Crossy Road Celebration Frames

13 agents x 1 jump-peak frame = 13 sprites at 128x128 transparent PNG.

The victory moment. Arms in V, lifted 20px, star particles, confetti dots, green checkmark badge.

Design

  • Position: Lifted 20px above ground (higher than hop peak of 14px)
  • Body: Slightly stretched (scaleX: 0.95, scaleY: 1.06)
  • Arms: Raised in V formation (-55deg left, +55deg right)
  • Eyes: Happy curves (0 0 3px 3px border-radius, downward)
  • Mouth: Wide smile (14px, bottom border only)
  • Legs: Spread apart (24px offset vs normal 28px)
  • Aura: 100% intensity, expanded radius (-12px inset)
  • Shadow: Compressed (scaleX: 0.6), low opacity (0.2), 24px below character
  • Stars: 4 spinning star particles in signature color
  • Confetti: 4 colored dots (gold, red, cyan, green)
  • Checkmark: 18px green circle with white check, top-right

Bobby Integration

Trigger conditions

  • Task completed
  • Milestone reached
  • Level up
  • Achievement unlocked
  • Project done

Animation sequence

  1. Crossfade from current state to celebration sprite (100ms, scale(1.15) pop)
  2. CSS bounce: translateY(-20px) to translateY(0), 500ms ease-out
  3. Repeat bounce 2-3 times
  4. Pair with confetti-burst effect (3 frames, 360ms)
  5. Hold celebration pose for 1-2 seconds
  6. Crossfade back to idle (300ms)

CSS for bounce

@keyframes celebrate-bounce {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.15); }
  40% { transform: translateY(-20px) scale(1.0); }
  60% { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.03); }
  80% { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.0); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.0); }
}

.agent-celebrating {
  animation: celebrate-bounce 500ms ease-out;
  animation-iteration-count: 3;
}
